The issuer demonstrates solid top-line revenue ($11.3B) and profitable operations ($938M EBIT), but exhibits notable credit weaknesses including negative retained earnings (-$239M), moderate leverage (liabilities-to-assets of ~61.6%), and a modest current ratio (~1.44x). Net income exceeding EBIT indicates significant non-operating gains or tax benefits, masking an otherwise mid-single-digit operating margin (~8.3%) that aligns with a lower-tier investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB-
